description: The latest position on record for the aircraft with this ICAO 24-bit address, however old: latitude, longitude, barometric altitude, ground speed, course, on-ground state and callsign (both null unless reported in the last 15 minutes), when it was reported and its age in seconds. live is true only when it is at most 180 seconds old, two of GADUIN's 90-second reading intervals; an older position is the latest on record, not where the aircraft is now. Not found when no position of the aircraft was recorded in the last 90 days. Positions are what the aircraft's own transponder broadcast, picked up by ground receivers and relayed to GADUIN with a delay, so reported_at_utc, not the time of the request, is when the aircraft was there; where no receiver hears the aircraft (over oceans and remote land) there is no position for that stretch.

icao24.description: The aircraft's ICAO 24-bit address as six hex digits, e.g. 4ca7b2 (get_flight_status reports it under aircraft).
